name: light_flashlight_cone
kind: light texture (PointLight2D), the girl's flashlight beam
tip_note: the beam's tip, px-edge coordinates from the top-left: flashlight.gd `beam_tip_pixels` (the old prop_radius_0.png used (24, 78.5)); put it on the girl's `flashlight_tip` anchor
direction: +x (the cone points to the right of the texture); symmetric about y = 64
scale_note: 13 u reach: flashlight.gd sets texture_scale = beam_length_u * 32 / 256 = 1.625 (world px), = 4.06 art px per texture px; the whole-number art scale is 4 (12.8 u). The brief allows whole-number scales only for light textures.
filter: nearest (project default_texture_filter 0), so the bands stay hard
energy_note: the brightest band is #bab4aa (0.71), so at energy 1 the lit floor peaks at albedo x 0.87 (house) / 0.73 (tutorial); the old texture peaked at white. Raise beam_energy to ~1.3-1.4 for the old peak (for Beti / the Godot session).
breath_hold_note: flashlight.gd squeezes node scale.y to 0.45 on breath hold; the bands are >= 3 px across the beam so they survive it (see review/light_flashlight_cone_aims.png)
design: option C 'hand-made' (critic pick): a hot core tongue from the lens, band edges drifting 1-3 px, shoulder steps at the 2nd / 3rd band ends, a far end of three broad lobes
